## Transform your business with custom AI agents

- ### Build conversational capabilities











Design agents that respond to natural language prompts with a conversational flow—answering questions, guiding workflows, or completing tasks using your business data.







[Read a customer story](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2320701&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Add autonomous capabilities











Build agents that manage tasks or business processes autonomously—planning, learning, and escalating work items when needed.







[Read the blog](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2296143&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Use pre-built agents and templates











Get ready-to-use agents from the Agent Store or start with a template and customize it based on your business needs.







[Read the blog](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2320525&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)





![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/OverviewandFeatures_Overview_1.3?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&wid=1664&hei=1062&qlt=100&fit=constrain)

- ### Design agents with voice











Create voice or phone-based agents powered by generative AI to help users and customers more quickly—and free service representatives for more complex cases.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339091&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)


- ### Ground agents with your organization’s knowledge











Work IQ is the intelligence layer behind Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents that helps Copilot know you, your job, and your company. Tap into Work IQ to build custom agents tuned to your workflows and business needs, as well as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and more than 1,400 external connectors.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339092&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Add structured instructions











Set clear guidelines for how your agent responds—using prompts, formatting rules, or summaries—to ensure consistency and accuracy.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339707&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Enable agents to complete tasks











Build agents that can complete actions on your behalf through a variety of tools such as flows, prompts, and APIs that connect to your business systems.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339291&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Create multi-agent systems











Use multi-agent orchestration for complex processes, routing tasks to the right agent when specialized knowledge or actions are required. You can connect agents, whether from Microsoft or partner providers, to work together.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2320700&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)


- ### Publish to where you work











Deploy your agents directly in the Microsoft 365 apps your employees use every day—such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.







[Learn more](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot/blog/copilot-studio/publish-your-microsoft-copilot-studio-agents-to-microsoft-365-copilot/)

- ### Embed in websites or social channels











Publish agents in the tools or channels your customers already use, from web apps to messaging platforms.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339313&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Integrate with business apps











Use agents with custom apps or workflows to amplify line-of-business processes.







[Read a customer story](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2325820&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)


- ### Manage your agents











Protect data, control agent creation and sharing, and measure impact—all through the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339094&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Govern with scale and innovation











Manage dedicated development environments, employ agent lifecycle management controls, and oversee agent spend in the Power Platform admin center.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339315&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Access analytics and reporting











Track readiness and adoption of agents, audit agent actions and usage, and track agent ROI using Microsoft Purview, the Power Platform admin center, and Viva Insights.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339294&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

- ### Protect your enterprise data











Safeguard sensitive information, help ensure AI security, and maintain compliance—powered by the governance tools in Power Platform.







[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339316&clcid=0x409&culture=en-us&country=us)

## Frequently asked questions

Expand all

Collapse all

- 01/











### What is Microsoft Copilot Studio?




















Copilot Studio is an end-to-end conversational AI platform that empowers you to create agents using natural language or a graphical interface. With Copilot Studio, you can easily design, test, and publish agents for your needs. You can build a standalone agent or publish to Microsoft 365 Copilot.

- 02/











### What is an agent?






















Agents are expert systems that surface in different channels, including in the background of Copilot. Copilot can bring together many agents into a simple interface for easy access.



Agents use AI to automate and execute business processes, for a person, team, or organization. They range from simple to advanced and may include those that:



  - Answer user questions by retrieving or summarizing information.
  - Take actions when asked, automate workflows, and replace repetitive tasks.
  - Operate independently, dynamically plan, learn, and escalate.

- 03/











### What are the benefits of publishing your agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot?




















With Copilot Studio, you can build agents and publish them anywhere, including Microsoft 365 Copilot. When you publish to Copilot, your organization benefits from being able to use that agent within the applications your employees frequently work in, such as Teams, SharePoint, and [Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/chat).

- 04/











### Is Microsoft Power Virtual Agents part of Copilot Studio?




















Yes. What was formerly known as Microsoft Power Virtual Agents is now included in Microsoft Copilot Studio, so you can continue using the same features—alongside additional capabilities for creating and orchestrating agents.

- 05/











### How does Copilot Studio approach responsible AI?




















Generative AI within Copilot Studio is designed to align with our responsible AI principles, including fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, transparency, inclusiveness, and accountability.



[Learn more](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/ai/responsible-ai)

- 06/











### Which languages does Copilot Studio support?




















Copilot Studio supports Chinese (simplified and traditional), Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, and Turkish.



[Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2263271)

- 07/











### What's the difference between Copilot Studio in Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Copilot Studio licensed separately?




















Copilot Studio is the comprehensive tool for building agents. Agents built in Copilot Studio can be deployed across multiple channels—organizations pay only for usage when they select the pay-as-you-go plan. For those licensed for Microsoft 365 Copilot, usage of agents published to Microsoft 365 Copilot is included in their license.

- 08/











### How can I purchase Microsoft Copilot Studio?






























Copilot Studio is sold as tenant-wide Copilot Credit packs of 25,000 Copilot Credits each, priced at $200.00/pack/month. Whenever an action or response is completed by an agent, a varying number of Copilot Credits will be billed depending on the specific usage. The triggered action or response is included in the original billable Copilot Credit and doesn’t count as a separate billable Copilot Credit.



Copilot Studio is also available to sign up for as a pay-as-you-go meter in addition to the existing Copilot Credits packs. This will allow customers the flexibility to only pay for the Copilot Credits they consume at the end of their monthly billing period, after use. This new pay-as-you-go meter requires no upfront license commitment, allowing customers to scale usage and help ensure business continuity for critical business processes.



This product is not available in your market.

- 09/











### Are there any product differences between the Copilot Credit packs and the pay-as-you-go meter?






























There are no in-product features or capability differences between the Copilot Credit pack and the pay-as-you-go meter. The only difference is the way a customer pays for the service. With Copilot Credit packs, customers pay up front ($200.00/pack/month for 25,000 Copilot Credits). The pay-as-you-go meter requires no up-front license commitment and allows customers to pay only for the Copilot Credit capacity they use at the end of the billing period.



[Download the licensing guide](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2320995)



This product is not available in your market.

- 10/











### How do I set up a pay-as-you-go meter for Copilot Studio?




















In order to set up pay-as-you-go billing for an environment, you first need an active Azure subscription that you can link to that environment. [Read the documentation](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2339329) to learn more.
